House rules

Nine lines. None of them are enforced by the software, which is the point — this is the part of a place that only the people in it can keep.

  1. Bring people you would vouch for.Your name stays on their page. That is the whole system: there is no committee, only whether you were careful.
  2. If you swap cards, reply.Somebody gave you a way to reach them because you asked for it. Silence after that is the one thing that makes people stop giving.
  3. Do not pitch in the wrong room.Somebody looking for a language exchange did not ask about your company. Tick the box for what you want and the people who want it will find you.
  4. Do not screenshot somebody into a group chat.Everything here was written for the people in here. A screenshot moves it somewhere its author never agreed to be.
  5. Nobody here owes you a reply.Not a follow back, not a card, not a match. Asking twice is fine. Asking a third time is not.
  6. Do not guess who looked at your page.The number is deliberately anonymous. On a board this small a guess is usually wrong and always awkward for the person you guessed.
  7. Post your own face, not somebody else's.A photograph is the one thing that cannot be taken back once somebody has saved it.
  8. Report it rather than arguing with it.A person reads every report, and two of them hide a post until somebody has. A thread of people arguing helps nobody who comes after.
  9. Leave it better than a group chat.That is the only bar. Everything above is a way of saying it more precisely.

Nothing here is a threat. Somebody who ignores all nine will be removed by a person, and the person who brought them will be told — which is also the only enforcement there is.
